fact: The Central Bank of the Comoros issued Regulation n°01/2017/BCC/DSBR setting the conditions and modalities for exercising e-money activity; the document gives only the year 2017 (published date used).
The regulation cites as a legal basis decree n°15-026/PR of 3 March 2015 on payment systems, means and incidents of payment.
The Banque Centrale des Comores lists Telco Money SA and Hury Money SA among the legally established electronic money institutions in the Union of the Comoros as at its December 2025 communique.
